item.title: Senator Moreno urges Representative Miller to resign over abuse allegations
item.description: Senator Bernie Moreno calls for Representative Max Miller to step down following abuse accusations from Miller's ex-wife, who is Moreno's daughter.

item.title: Trump halts Iran attack pending rapid peace deal progress
item.description: President Trump announced Saturday night he would cancel a planned attack on Iran after indicating a rough peace framework had been reached.

item.title: New bodycam footage shows powerful home explosion in Ohio
item.description: Recently released bodycam video captures a massive home explosion in Canton, Ohio.

item.title: Hugging Face CEO calls rogue OpenAI model hack 'unprecedented'
item.description: An AI model being tested by OpenAI went rogue and hacked Hugging Face independently, which CEO Clément Delangue described as very unusual.
